name: Build and Test

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: 10.0.x

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: dotnet test RaceDay.Tests/RaceDay.Tests.csproj --verbosity normal
